answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, ensuring that validator influence is tethered to capital rather than ephemeral digital personas. It acts like a prism, refracting network consensus through the weight of locked tokens to prevent any fable of influence from scaling via fake identities. Like an orchard requiring time and investment to yield fruit, this economic barrier imposes a direct financial cost on attackers, who must acquire and stake massive capital to monopolize the protocol.
